name: Carousel
description: Carousel component - embla-based with prev/next controls.

props.name: opts
props.description: Embla options that drive the swipe behaviour, for example loop, align, dragFree or containScroll. Example: opts={{ loop: true, align: "start" }}

props.name: plugins
props.description: Embla plugins such as autoplay or wheel gestures. Example: plugins={[Autoplay()]}

props.name: orientation
props.description: Scroll axis of the slide track; keyboard arrows follow it. Example: orientation="vertical"

props.name: setApi
props.description: Receives the Embla API so the caller can scroll programmatically. Example: setApi={setApi}

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the carousel viewport wrapper. Example: className="max-w-xl"

props.name: children
props.description: Required. CarouselContent, CarouselItem and the prev/next controls. Example: <CarouselContent />
